places.name: Notre Dame Cathedral
places.ai_summary: A stunning French colonial cathedral with twin bell towers, located in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City.

opening_hours.notes: Mass timings may affect visiting hours.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.
places.address: Notre Dame Cathedral, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

places.name: Ben Thanh Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling market offering a variety of goods, from souvenirs to local street food, in a vibrant atmosphere.
places.place_tip: Bargain for the best prices and try the local food stalls.
places.address: Ben Thanh Market, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

places.name: War Remnants Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history and consequences of the Vietnam War, with exhibits including military vehicles and weapons.
places.place_tip: Take your time to read the detailed exhibits and watch the documentary films.
places.address: 28 Vo Van Tan, Ward 6, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

places.name: Independence Palace
places.ai_summary: The former presidential palace of South Vietnam, now a museum displaying artifacts from the Vietnam War.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays and public holidays.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn more about the history and significance of the palace.
places.address: 135 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia, Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

places.name: Saigon Central Post Office
places.ai_summary: A beautiful example of French colonial architecture, this post office is still in operation and a popular tourist spot.
places.place_tip: Don't forget to buy some postcards and souvenirs from the gift shop inside.
places.address: 2 Cong Xa Paris, Ben Nghe, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

places.ai_summary: An extensive network of underground tunnels used during the Vietnam War, now a popular historical site.

opening_hours.notes: Be respectful of worshippers and the religious significance of the site.
